The Design Process: Engineering design process
The iterative method engineers use to solve problems
Define the problem
The first step, stating the need clearly and specifically
Design brief
A written statement of the problem, constraints, and criteria
Criteria
The requirements a successful solution must meet
Constraint
A limitation such as budget, size, material, or time
Research phase
Investigating existing solutions and relevant science
Brainstorming
Generating many possible solutions without early judgement
Concept sketch
A quick drawing communicating an early idea
Decision matrix
A scored table comparing concepts against weighted criteria
Prototype
A working model built to test a design
Testing
Evaluating whether a prototype meets the criteria
Iteration
Revising a design based on test results
Optimization
Refining a working design to improve performance
Trade-off
Accepting a loss in one criterion to gain in another
Failure as information
Treating a failed test as data rather than defeat
Communicating the solution
Presenting the design with drawings, data, and reasoning
